_note: Proposed rows for phone-app/content/questions.csv (then `npm run questions`). Same shape as src/app-core/data/interview.js entries. `rewrite: true` means the id already exists and this row replaces it. `about` is null where only the storyteller can answer. See docs/research/questions-2026.md.

questions.question: What were you told about the day you were born?
questions.followUp: Who told you that story, and how often?
questions.hint: The weather, the hour, who was there, who was late. Hearsay is fine.
questions.about: What has {name} been told about the day they were born?

questions.question: Who in the family do you look like?
questions.followUp: And who do you act like?
questions.hint: The nose, the hands, the walk. Who said it when you were small.
questions.about: Who in the family does {name} look most like?

questions.question: How did your grandparents meet, as far as you know?
questions.followUp: Who told you the story?
questions.hint: Even a scrap. A dance, a farm, a boat, a shop counter.
questions.about: What does {name} know about how their grandparents met?

questions.question: What did your mother wear when she dressed up?
questions.followUp: How often did it come out of the wardrobe?
questions.hint: The one good dress, the shoes, the scent. Where she was going.
questions.about: What did {name}'s mother wear for best?

questions.question: What did your father sound like coming home?
questions.followUp: What did you do when you heard it?
questions.hint: The gate, the boots, the cough, the whistle. What changed in the room.

questions.question: How was a birthday marked in your house?
questions.followUp: Which birthday do you remember best?
questions.hint: A cake or no cake. A coin, a song, a day off chores, nothing at all.
questions.about: How does {name} like a birthday marked?

questions.question: What could you buy with the smallest coin you had?
questions.followUp: How did you get the coin?
questions.hint: Name the sweet, the shop, and who was behind the counter.
questions.about: What sweet does {name} still talk about from childhood?

questions.question: What did Saturday morning sound like at your house?
questions.followUp: Who was up first?
questions.hint: The radio, the washing, a parent shouting up the stairs. Or nothing until noon.

questions.question: Who owned a camera when you were a child?
questions.followUp: Where are those photographs now?
questions.hint: Whose it was, when it came out, and how you had to stand.
questions.about: Who took the photographs in {name}'s family?

questions.question: What was different about your best friend's house?
questions.followUp: What did your friend think of your house?
questions.hint: The smell, the food, the rules, the noise. What they had that you didn't.

questions.question: What did you eat at school in the middle of the day?
questions.followUp: Who did you sit with?
questions.hint: Carried from home, served in a hall, or you walked home for it.
questions.about: What did {name} take to school for lunch?

questions.question: What could you hear from bed when you were kept home sick?
questions.followUp: Who came up the stairs, and with what?
questions.hint: The house going on without you. The clock, the street, the kitchen.

questions.question: Tell me about your first morning at your first job.
questions.followUp: What did you do with the first money?
questions.hint: What you wore, how you got there, who showed you what to do.
questions.about: What was {name}'s first job?

questions.question: What was on your bedroom wall at sixteen?
questions.followUp: Who put it there?
questions.hint: A picture, a map, a saint, a singer, cracks. Or no wall of your own.

questions.question: Where were you on a Saturday night at eighteen?
questions.followUp: How did you get home?
questions.hint: The hall, the kitchen, the street corner, the night shift.
questions.about: Where did {name} go on Saturday nights when they were young?

questions.question: Which letter from those years did you keep?
questions.followUp: What did it say, roughly?
questions.hint: Who it was from and where it sat for years. If you burned them, say so.

questions.question: Who from your street went away to serve or to work far off?
questions.followUp: What came back with them?
questions.hint: You, a brother, a neighbour. Where they went and who waited.
questions.about: Who in {name}'s family went away to serve?

questions.question: Who have you shared a kitchen with the longest?
questions.followUp: What did the two of you argue about in that kitchen?
questions.hint: A husband, a wife, a sister, a friend, a lodger. Who cooked and who washed up.
questions.about: Who has {name} shared a home with the longest?

questions.question: Where did you go the first time you went out together?
questions.followUp: What did you talk about on the way home?
questions.hint: The picture house, the dance, a walk, a bus. What it cost and who paid.
questions.about: Where did {name} go on their first date?

questions.question: Which small child did you help raise, yours or not?
questions.followUp: What did they want from you, every time?
questions.hint: Your own, a niece, a neighbour's, a younger brother. What they called you.
questions.about: Which children did {name} help raise?

questions.question: Who did you telephone every week, for years?
questions.followUp: What did you always end up talking about?
questions.hint: A mother, a sister, a friend across the country. The day, the hour, what it cost.
questions.about: Who does {name} call every week?

questions.question: Where were you when you found out a baby was coming?
questions.followUp: Who did you tell first?
questions.hint: Yours, or one you were waiting on. The room, the look on someone's face.

questions.question: What did the house sound like at 3 a.m. with a new baby?
questions.followUp: Who did you ask when nothing worked?
questions.hint: Who got up. What you did to settle them. The one thing that worked.
questions.about: What does {name} say about the nights with a new baby?

questions.question: What did you wear to work?
questions.followUp: What did it smell of at the end of the day?
questions.hint: Uniform, overalls, a good shirt, an apron. Who washed it, and how often.
questions.about: What did {name} wear to work?

questions.question: What did your workplace sound like?
questions.followUp: What did you still hear in your head after you got home?
questions.hint: Machines, a till, children, cattle, a typewriter, a quiet you could hear the clock in.

questions.question: What did you bring home on your hands or clothes?
questions.followUp: What did your family say about it?
questions.hint: Flour, oil, chalk, ink, the smell of the ward, sawdust.
questions.about: What did {name} come home from work smelling of?

questions.question: What did you get wrong in your first month and never again?
questions.followUp: Who taught you the right way?
questions.hint: The mistake everyone makes once. Who caught it.

questions.question: When did the lights go out for everybody?
questions.followUp: Who turned up at your door?
questions.hint: A storm, a strike, a war, a power cut. What you did in the dark.
questions.about: What does {name} remember of the big blackout or storm?

questions.question: What food did you taste for the first time as an adult?
questions.followUp: What did you think of it then?
questions.hint: A pizza, a mango, a curry, sushi. Where, and who put it in front of you.
questions.about: What food did {name} discover late and love?

questions.question: What did you do as a child that would frighten a parent today?
questions.followUp: Did anything ever go wrong?
questions.hint: Out all day, on the back of a truck, down by the river, home by dark.
questions.about: What did {name} do as a kid that would frighten a parent today?

questions.question: Tell me about one day you knew was good while it was happening.
questions.followUp: What did you do with the evening?
questions.hint: One day, not a stretch. Where you were, who was there, what the weather did.
questions.about: Which day does {name} call one of the best of their life?

questions.question: Where were you when the news came that changed everything?
questions.followUp: Who did you tell first?
questions.hint: A phone, a doorway, a letter, a doctor's room. Who told you, and the next hour.

questions.question: Who did something small for you that turned out to be big?
questions.followUp: Did you ever get to thank them?
questions.hint: A lift, a loan, a word to the right person, a meal. Name them.
questions.about: Who gave {name} a break when it mattered?

questions.question: What did your place of worship smell like?
questions.followUp: Where did you sit, and who sat beside you?
questions.hint: Incense, wax, old wood, damp coats. Or the kitchen where your family kept quiet instead.

questions.question: Say the words your family says before a meal.
questions.followUp: Who says it, and who started it?
questions.hint: A grace, a toast, a joke, a silence. Word for word, in the language it's said in.
questions.about: What does {name} say before a meal?

questions.question: Which letter, call or visit do you wish you had made?
questions.followUp: What would the first line have been?
questions.hint: One. Who it was to, and what stopped you.

questions.question: What were you told at twenty that you only understood at fifty?
questions.followUp: Have you said it to anyone since?
questions.hint: One sentence. Who said it, where you were standing.

questions.question: What do you let a grandchild do that your own kids never could?
questions.followUp: What do they call you?
questions.hint: Ice cream before dinner, the late bedtime. Or a niece, a neighbour's child.
questions.about: What does {name} let a grandchild do that the kids never could?

questions.question: What would you ask {name} if you had one question?
questions.hint: Write it the way you'd say it across the table. It goes to them next.
questions.about: What would you ask {name} if you had one question?

questions.question: Who is in this photograph, and where was it taken?
questions.followUp: What happened just after the shutter clicked?
questions.hint: Start with the person you knew best. The year can be a guess.
questions.about: Who is in this photograph of {name}, and where was it taken?
